verdicts.reason: A shrinks the hero photo to an unreadable ~12px thumbnail stranded left of centre, leaves the yellow headline block floating in the middle with tiny text, and has a stray yellow sliver clipped at the top-right edge. Most of the banner is dead white, and the outline frame and the photo's role as the key image are gone. B is still weak: the headline block on the left and the small photo on the right sit at opposite ends of a vast empty middle, the photo is too small to carry the design, and the same yellow fragment is cut off at the top-right. Even so, B's headline is legible, the photo can be recognised, and the banner reads left to right.
